name: Mary Bryant Home for the Blind & Visually Impaired

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a Certified FOOD Protection Manager (CFPM) who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

The PIC during this inspection was without a CFPM certificate available. When asked no-one else that was currently in the facility had the certification either. The PIC stated that someone that works in the facility was able to teach the class and he was planning on taking it for moving forward. Ensure that there are enough CFPMs available to cover all shifts in which foods are being handled/prepared.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.citation_text:
3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

Two cans were observed with significant dents in the storage rack in the dry storage room. The cans were shown to the PIC and education conducted. The cans were then moved for discard/credit during the inspection to correct. Ensure that all cans with significant dents are put aside so that they are not used and potential Botulism infections prevented.
